title: MonetrixVault.setHlpDepositEnabled: missing access control
description: In MonetrixVault.setHlpDepositEnabled (src/core/MonetrixVault.sol) the access control modifier onlyOperator was removed, so any address can call this function.

title: sUSDM.setEscrow: missing check
description: In sUSDM.setEscrow (src/tokens/sUSDM.sol) the check "require(_escrow != address(0), "sUSDM: zero escrow");" was removed, so the condition is no longer enforced.

title: MonetrixVault.settle: off-by-one in a boundary check
description: In MonetrixVault.settle (src/core/MonetrixVault.sol) the comparison in "require(available >= proposedYield, "insufficient EVM USDC");" was shifted by one (>= became > or <= became <), an off-by-one in a boundary check.

title: MonetrixVault.reclaimFromRedeemEscrow: missing access control
description: In MonetrixVault.reclaimFromRedeemEscrow (src/core/MonetrixVault.sol) the access control modifier onlyOperator was removed, so any address can call this function.
